exclusions.source_text: ECOG performance status 0-1 (Karnofsky ≥70%, see Appendix A)
AST(SGOT)/ALT(SGPT) ≤2.5 × institutional upper limit of normal
creatinine ≤ 1.5 times the institutional upper limit of normal OR
Patients with ≤20 pack-years of cumulative cigarette smoking.
Prior history of head and neck cancer within 5 years.
symptomatic congestive heart failure, unstable angina pectoris, cardiac arrhythmia
Pregnant women are excluded from this study because of the teratogenic risks of radiation exposure to the developing fetus.
